stemMd: Which single discount is equivalent to successive discounts of 1/5 and 1/4 of the then-current price?
explanationMd: The retained price fraction is (4/5)(3/4)=3/5=60%. Therefore the total reduction is 40%, not the sum of the individual discounts.

distractorRationale.e: This is the fraction of price retained, not discounted.
distractorRationale.d: This adds the two percentage rates.
